assessment: This fundamental work significantly advances our understanding of genetic diversity in highly fecund organisms by showing that the Atlantic cod genome is prone to recurrent selective sweeps. The evidence supporting these conclusions is compelling, with rigorous analysis of the site frequency spectrum providing support for models of selective sweepstakes reproduction and multi-merger coalescents. This work will be of broad interest to evolutionary geneticists and should stimulate future work to determine whether random sweepstakes interact with selective sweepstakes.
